== Description ==

[[Joe Phillips]] (front left, black Columbia fleece over Star Wars tee), [[Jack Douglass]] (back left, blue beaver-logo tee, glasses, beard, hair bun), [[Ken Cross]] (front right, black Mario Kart tee, khaki shorts, short grey-blond hair), [[Mark Billings]] (back right, ponytail, glasses, black/gold chevron top), [[Garrett Larson]] (stream table back left, pink cap, beard), [[Daniel Amor]] (middle table right facing camera, green hoodie, glasses), [[Scott Lingrell]] (middle table (back), white hair, navy pullover), [[Logan Pietig]] (middle-left table facing away, black UWL hoodie), and [[Hayes Hunter]] (standing back right, tall bearded man in dark grey shirt, jeans) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
